name: Manchester Megaminx Day 2026
information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

**PLEASE NOTE:** This is a specialist competition. We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. 

The winner of Megaminx will be announced as the winner of the competition.
